summary: SEND-143 Item 2 (Phase 2 Linear Trim Runs) frontend verification on EST-373526, photo 0 (FRONT ELEVATION). Data discipline honoured: every mark drawn during the run was deleted and the scale was cleared at teardown; EST-886440 was never touched; Apply Measurements was never pressed.

verification_evidence.item1_panel_and_7_rows: photo-takeoff-trim-panel present; header 'Linear runs — confirmed marks only'; 7 rows in exact order: outside_corner, inside_corner, j_channel, starter, soffit, fascia, gable_rake — data-testids match spec.
verification_evidence.item2_empty_state_em_dash_and_named_refu: With nothing drawn, every photo-takeoff-trim-lf-<key> reads the em dash '—' and NONE contains '0' or '0 LF'. Refusal sentences read verbatim: Starter='no wall BASE is marked on this photo…'; Soffit='no EAVE is marked on this photo — the roof edge is not invented. Mark the eave to measure soffit'; Fascia='no EAVE is marked on this photo — the horizontal fascia run is not invented. Mark the eave to measure it. The GABLE RAKE is measured separately, from the rake lines already drawn'; Outside/Inside corners='no corner is marked on this photo, and no wall here carries a confirmed height — mark the corner and measure that wall's height on this photo. No height is copied from another wall, another photo or another estimate'. J-channel and gable_rake also print their own refusals in the empty state.
verification_evidence.item3_j_channel_measures_drawn_box: After setting the two-tap anchor + typing 10 ft span-commit, drawing a rect opening (two taps) and clicking photo-takeoff-confirm-<id>, photo-takeoff-trim-lf-j_channel = '25 LF' (real figure), photo-takeoff-trim-basis-j_channel = 'perimeter of every box drawn round an opening on this photo', and photo-takeoff-trim-item-j_channel-<markId> = 'opening 25 LF · perimeter of the box drawn on this photo · 5.0 ft × 7.5 ft · 25.0 LF'. Matches spec 'perimeter of the box drawn on this photo · W ft × H ft · N LF' exactly.
verification_evidence.item7_unconfirmed_mark_feeds_nothing: Immediately after drawing the box opening but before confirming, photo-takeoff-trim-lf-j_channel still read '—' — a provisional mark contributes nothing.
verification_evidence.item8_phase1_no_regression: photo-takeoff-qty-gable is present and Live Quantities panel renders unchanged; siding/opening/gable ft² and gable dims lines still print (screenshot 1 shows GABLE·141.75 ft²·provisional label on the drawn triangle).
verification_evidence.no_zero_anywhere: Full-panel text scan confirms no '0 LF' substring in the trim panel at any state during the run (empty, provisional, and confirmed states).

not_exercised_via_ui.item4_point_opening_refuses_j_channel: The PhotoTakeoffEditor Opening tool ALWAYS produces a rect from two taps (see PhotoTakeoffEditor.jsx around lines 264-268). There is no UI affordance to create a shape='point' opening. Backend _j_channel logic that refuses a point-shape opening with 'count only — this opening is a tap with no drawn extent; box it…' is exercised by /app/backend/tests/test_send143_trim_and_names_2026_08_28.py.
not_exercised_via_ui.item5_gable_rake_from_drawn_triangle: The gable was drawn (visible as green 'GABLE·141.75 ft²·provisional' triangle in screenshot 1) but the automated confirm-click step could not resolve the gable mark id because photo-takeoff-gable-dims-<id> only renders after the row is expanded — the detection loop searched before expansion. The gable_rake row therefore remained at em dash with its no-drawn-triangle refusal. UI logic (photo-takeoff-trim-item-gable_rake-<markId>, 'gable zone' tag, span/rise/LF basis) is not verified in-browser this iteration but is covered by the 23-pin backend pytest suite.
not_exercised_via_ui.item6_flat_gable_no_rake: Same reason as item 5 — the mark id was not resolved to click confirm.

action_items: Optional: consider rendering the gable dims/action row-actions block based on the mark's kind (not on row selection) so downstream automated tests can find the confirm button without a two-step (select-then-confirm) probe. Not a defect — a testability nice-to-have.
critical_code_review_comments: TrimPanel.jsx is a pure printer — every LF and every sentence comes from qty.trim_rows (server-owned); the panel decides nothing. `lf(v)` prints '—' whenever v is null. Zero regressions expected.
PhotoTakeoffEditor.jsx line 580 mounts <TrimPanel qty={qty} /> exactly below <QuantitiesPanel qty={qty} /> — correct.

Backend photo_takeoff.py: _trim_rows/_j_channel/_gable_rake honour the 'evidence-or-null' rule verbatim — every no-mark lane returns lf=None and NAMES the missing mark; nothing is deducted; the rake is tagged zone='gable' and never sums into wall lanes. Perimeter formula matches the drawn box (avg of opposing edges for W ft × H ft in the basis line).
Live math in this run: 5.0 ft × 7.5 ft box → perimeter 25.0 LF, confirmed on screen (5 + 7.5 + 5 + 7.5 = 25.0).
seed_data_creation: None — one box opening and one gable were drawn during the run and both deleted at teardown; the scale was cleared. EST-373526 returned to as-found state; EST-886440 untouched.
